test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average production of milk over four years for brand P = (40 + 20 + 40 + 20)/4 = 120/4

Average production of milk over four years for brand Q = (50 + 25 + 30 + 30) = 135/4

Average production of milk over four years for brand R = (30 + 30 + 20 + 25) = 105/4

Average production (in million tons) per year over the period of 4 years for three brands = (120/4 + 135/4 + 105/4)

⇒ 360/4 = 90

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
